name: Prophets Reward
overview: Scripture reveals that those who receive and honor prophets do so not only as messengers but as representatives of God Himself, promising them a prophet's reward as Jesus taught in Matthew 10. This reward is linked to faithful hospitality and generosity, as shown by the assurance in Mark 9 that even giving a cup of water in Christ's name will not go unrewarded. The call to generosity and sacrificial following, exemplified in Mark 10, underscores that true reward is found in aligning with Christ's mission and embracing His cross. Ultimately, the eternal nature of God's word, settled forever in heaven as Psalm 119 declares, assures believers that such rewards are grounded in the unchanging truth of God’s kingdom.
